trials.claimQuote: 5,000 credits per month for GBP, Bing, and LinkedIn leads searches
trials.reasoning: Buyers report a small search limit imposed after purchase and only about 650 leads per month, so the advertised 5,000 monthly credits are not actually usable as promised.

exhibits.quote: We have a Tier 2 liscence that claims up to 10,000 emails/month - and we are averaging 60 - 120 per search and a total volume 650 PER MONTH.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports receiving only 650 per month despite 10,000 credit claim, showing credits are not actually usable.

exhibits.quote: To top it off the offer details list a high number of monthly credits and yet they implemented a very small search limit after we purchased
exhibits.argument: Buyer says a small search limit imposed after purchase prevents using the advertised high monthly credits.
